feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Maintenance gone awry caused nation-wide ground stop, says Transportation Secretary
entry.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy points blame toward contractor in explaining Friday's nation-wide aviation ground stop.

entry.title: Hello? James Gleick's new book compares the history of the telephone to the modern era
entry.summary: Have you ever wondered where phone etiquette or the idea for the first social network came from? Author James Gleick talks about his new book, The Telephone.

entry.title: An NPR correspondent on what she learned following special education teachers all year
entry.summary: NPR's Jonaki Mehta talks about she learned from following special education teachers throughout a school year.

entry.title: Mathis Picard finds grounding in an uncertain world in his new album, The Sound Orchestra
entry.summary: French Malagasy pianist, composer, and producer Mathis Picard releases his newest album, The Sound Orchestra.

entry.title: Why the government's Hurricane Helene recovery effort in North Carolina was so slow
entry.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Blue Ridge Public Radio's Gerard Albert III about his new podcast A Man-Made Disaster.

entry.title: SpaceX makes history with Starship catch
entry.summary: SpaceX catches its Starship rocket as it comes back from space for the very first time.

entry.title: Commerce Department under pressure for delaying export controls on Nvidia chips
entry.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department is under scrutiny for clearing Chinese companies to handle Nvidia chips, despite national security concerns from cabinet officials and U.S. intelligence agencies.

entry.title: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
entry.summary: Chile's far-right President José Antonio Kast is facing mounting public anger, as rising fuel prices trigger transport strikes and protests across the country.

entry.title: The role of a pilot during a ground stop, according to an expert
entry.summary: As the nationwide aviation ground stop continues, there are still planes in the sky. Pilots are having to navigate this situation as we continue to learn more.

entry.title: What passengers at D.C.'s Reagan National Airport say about the FAA ground stop
entry.summary: All flights across the United States are grounded and millions of passengers are stranded. NPR talked to passengers at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.
